identity_check: Confirmed as Didero (didero.ai), the New York startup selling AI agents for direct-spend procurement and supply-chain work at manufacturers and distributors; the company site, its own Series A and launch posts, TechCrunch (2024 and 2026), SiliconANGLE and Construct Capital's investment note all describe the same company and the same co-founders (Tim Spencer, Lorenz Pallhuber, Tom Petit). Not Covalent AI (covalentmarket.com), an AI purchasing tool Didero acquired in July 2025. Category set to direct (not in the PROJECT_CONTEXT §7 seed list; candidate found through Construct Capital's portfolio): Didero's agents do procurement work for manufacturers — supplier follow-ups, PO coordination, sourcing and quoting, receiving and AP — which is Utopian Autonomy's procurement / RFQ wedge, and TechCrunch frames it as 'manufacturing procurement'. Differences: it serves procurement, supply-chain and AP teams through the ERP and email (it also ingests WeChat messages and calls), not plant-floor staff over WhatsApp; many named customers are distributors or consumer-goods firms; it does not touch maintenance, process stability or engineering drawings. Layer plant_ops is the nearest fit (no supply-chain layer in the taxonomy), as for Galvant and SalesPatriot.

company.name: Didero
company.description: New York startup selling AI agents that run direct-spend procurement work (supplier follow-ups, POs, sourcing, AP) on top of manufacturers' and distributors' ERPs.

layer_detail: Procurement / supply-chain back office rather than the plant floor: agents for planning and replenishment, sourcing and quoting, master data and contracts, PO management, logistics and delivery, AP and supplier performance reporting, running on the customer's ERP (e.g. Epicor at Echelon) and reading supplier emails, WeChat messages, calls, POs and packing lists. Users are procurement, supply-chain and AP teams. 'plant_ops' is the nearest layer; there is no supply-chain layer in the taxonomy.
product_summary: AI agents that sit on a company's existing ERP and inbox and execute direct-spend work: supplier communication and follow-ups, PO creation and tracking, sourcing and quoting, contracts and master data, receiving, invoice / AP processing and supplier reporting. Reads emails, WeChat messages, calls, POs and packing lists; suppliers change nothing.
